corpus.text: Principal component analysis projects centered data onto orthogonal directions of maximum variance. The first principal component retains the largest variance.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Standardizing features before PCA prevents a feature with a large numeric scale from dominating the covariance matrix.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: PCA directions are eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Corresponding eigenvalues measure variance along each component.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: PCA is unsupervised dimensionality reduction. It does not use class labels to choose principal components.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: A support vector machine chooses a separating hyperplane with maximum margin. Support vectors are training points nearest the decision boundary.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: The kernel trick evaluates inner products in a transformed feature space without computing the transformation explicitly.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Soft-margin SVM permits margin violations. The parameter C controls the penalty for violations.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: The SVM dual problem uses Lagrange multipliers and pairwise inner products between training examples.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Precision is true positives divided by true positives plus false positives. It measures how many predicted positives are correct.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Recall is true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives. It measures how many actual positives were found.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: The F1 score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall: two times precision times recall divided by their sum.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Accuracy is the number of correct predictions divided by all predictions. It can be misleading for imbalanced classes.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: K-nearest neighbors predicts from neighboring labeled training points. It has no explicit maximum-margin optimization.
corpus.subject: Machine Learning

corpus.text: Linear discriminant analysis uses class labels and seeks directions that separate classes rather than preserve total variance.
